description: Skelet AF-14a: authorized corpus importer with flow read surfaces (MCP plus REST plus skill plus migration 016 plus CI wiring)

compatibility.instructions: Does this grain preserve all contracts: skelet.agent.v1 envelope unchanged, existing tools/routes/rankings untouched, migration 016 purely additive (flow ledger admission with guards and rollback), ImportRecord union widened by one member, tool inventory 18->20 updated in three tests, migration lists updated across db suites? Any renamed tool, changed route, or altered search behavior?

correctness.instructions: Is the importer correct: whole-corpus validation before first write, per-entity ledger lookup with fingerprint conflict detection, identical replay returning same IDs with zero new rows, flow steps ordered by position, list visibility requiring all steps readable, budgets with truncation flags, MCP/REST deep-equal parity? Do the 6 corpus tests plus 2 transport tests prove counts, replay, conflict, zero-write failures, scoping, pagination, and validation?

evidence.instructions: Is evidence sufficient: ingest 14/14, web/node/worker 114/114, db non-PG 113/113 including up/down rollback with 016, python 178/178, all validators PASS, lint/typecheck clean on touched workspaces, graft build/check green, real-PG suites wired in CI for exact-head proof? Any passing-test-only claim without integration coverage?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterminism or resource risk: are fingerprints over fixed key orders, is flow examination capped at 200 with truncation flags, are step inserts position-ordered deterministically, does the down migration restore the exact prior CHECK and function body, do validation caps bound every collection?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond bounded corpus import plus flow reads: product/version gallery UI, flow player, pattern taxonomy, rrweb capture, get_changes, MCP Apps, embeddings, billing, or unrelated refactors? Are those explicitly deferred?

security.instructions: Do the R2 guarantees hold: import restricted to explicit rights with no defaults, workspace/owner bindings validated, flow listing filters before pagination with single-unreadable-step denial and no oracle (tested both orders plus malformed), request IDs and cursors sanitized, error bodies static with leak assertions, ledger immutability and delete guards extended to flows, no shell/subprocess/network?

state.change: AF-14a corpus: packages/ingest/src/corpus.ts plus tests, migration 016 up/down, workflows ImportRecord flow member, list_flows/get_flow_steps MCP tools plus two REST routes, research skill step, validator promotion, CI ingest wiring, migration inventory updates. 29 files.
